commands.note: Respect macOS keyboard settings; keep native focus/menu alternatives

navigation.dates: Left/Right +/-1 day; Up/Down +/-7; Home/End week bounds; PageUp/PageDown month clamped to valid day; Shift+Page year
navigation.weekStart: Follow the displayed week-start setting; Windows reference uses Sunday
navigation.tabs: Left/Right/Home/End; Delete closes focused day tab; restore active tab focus
navigation.search: Down from input; Up at first result returns to input; Return opens
navigation.menus: Native menu arrows/typeahead/Escape; menu keys must not move widgets
navigation.time: Up/Down/Home/End/PageUp/PageDown; Left/Right columns; A/P in period; Return confirms; Escape cancels

guards: Pause single-key shortcuts in text editors and during IME composition
A native accelerator cannot replace an open editor
Restore focus by stable ID after rerender, otherwise a visible logical fallback
A late autofocus callback cannot override user-chosen focus

widget.selection: Arrows move; Shift+Arrows resize; Return creates; Escape cancels
widget.panel: Focused header arrows move 10 pt, Shift 40 pt; focused grip arrows resize; options menu keys never move panel
widget.persistence: Serialize or coalesce frame saves; removing during a pending save cannot resurrect the widget
